notes.content:
This 1.0.3 is just a small update, mainly to add the main menu link for Ep. 3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520110/Milfvania_Ep_3/

This is going to be the final version, a couple of hours playtime, much longer than 1 & 2. [b]Wishlist it[/b], i will post there the development progress.

notes.title: Added better gallery, achievements and a bugfix
notes.content:
Today I rolled the update mentioned a few days ago:

You should have:
[list]
[*]Scene gallery with animation, text, sound, music
[*]Achievements (you must replay the game again, sry)
[*]Fixed a bug mentioned by a player when you have to option to "Charge". If you "Play it cool" you skip the mechanic workshop altogether
[/list]

[b]The winter special DLC scene for Ep. 1 is still in planning. The girl with most votes will have a special scene featured as a FREE DLC for Ep. 1. Express your suggestion now.[/b]

notes.title: Milfvania Ep. 1 is now released!
notes.content:
Game is now available. I'm here to fix any bugs that might appear. Avast might report it as a false positive.

🌟Next on the roadmap
[list]
[*]Add achievements
[*]Translation to languages other than english
[*]Prepare release for Ep. 2 in just two weeks from now.
[/list]
